source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 中国人民抗日战争胜利81周年纪念日
topics.official_english: China Marks 81st Anniversary of Victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression
topics.why_hot: September 3 is an officially observed date in China for the victory over Japan, and this topic rallies commemorative posts and reflections online.
topics.share_angle: Explain the date's meaning in Chinese public memory and how this annual commemoration is framed for Chinese audiences.

topics.official_english: Global Stock Markets Stage a Major Reversal
topics.why_hot: Sharp swings in stock markets immediately affect portfolios and sentiment, so the word "reversal" draws broad investor attention worldwide.
topics.share_angle: Explain what a market reversal is, how talk of one spreads before full data is available, and why headlines like this should be read with care.

topics.chinese_topic: 微信新功能专治各种看不见
topics.official_english: WeChat Introduces a New Feature to Tackle Different "Can't See" Issues
topics.why_hot: The headline is deliberately vague, so users are curious to learn what the new update actually does and how it changes everyday messaging.
topics.share_angle: Avoid overclaiming about the feature; instead show how Chinese audiences discover app changes through cryptic update notes and viral discussions.

topics.chinese_topic: 荷兰将约86吨黄金储备从美加转至英国
topics.official_english: Netherlands Shifts About 86 Tons of Gold Reserves From US and Canada to UK
topics.why_hot: Gold-transfer stories mix mystery with finance, prompting questions about why countries keep bullion abroad and what such a move might signal.
topics.share_angle: Offer a quick explainer on central bank gold storage, the history of overseas reserves, and how gold-repatriation stories are reported.

topics.chinese_topic: 七日酒店遭7天酒店索赔10万
topics.official_english: 7 Days Inn Sues Qiri Hotel for 100,000 Yuan
topics.why_hot: The two hotel names both connect to the idea of "seven days," making this a simple but sharp example of a brand-name dispute.
topics.share_angle: Use the case to discuss trademarks, business naming, and why even a small wording difference can become a legal problem.

topics.chinese_topic: 广西横州养蛇厂家：养蛇是为了救人
topics.official_english: Snake Breeding Business in Hengzhou, Guangxi Says Raising Snakes Is for Saving Lives
topics.why_hot: The phrase contrasts an often-feared animal with a life-saving purpose, prompting both curiosity and debate.
topics.share_angle: Give a balanced look at how snake breeding can be linked to medical needs and why the industry remains controversial.

topics.chinese_topic: 《后西游记》没真人演员却拿下收视第1
topics.official_english: "The Later Journey to the West" Tops TV Ratings Without Using Real Actors
topics.why_hot: A familiar story remade without real actors raises questions about how television content is produced today and what audiences expect from performances.
topics.share_angle: Use this as a hook to discuss virtual characters, changing acting standards, and how entertainment trends are shaped by new production methods.
keywords: The Later Journey to the West

topics.chinese_topic: 时光见证中埃情谊历久弥新
topics.official_english: China-Egypt Friendship Stands the Test of Time
topics.why_hot: The phrase appears as a leading Baidu hot list item with official-style language, signaling media attention to the long-running China-Egypt relationship.
topics.share_angle: Provide background on China-Egypt exchanges and decode the diplomatic phrasing used in Chinese official narratives.
